items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: He used to play with us.

ctx.x: Who? Who's that? You want to turn the machine off? We can go through another picture. Yeah, let's go. Sit down. Well, we got everybody confirmed in the picture of Sidney Duesen and Rose for Tushan. Yeah. Except Wilson you didn't recognize. The one they call Wilson. Or the guy that's second from left, or the right of Nelson.
Well, Sam Dutra, he died there late. Yeah. He used to play with us. Yeah. He used to play with us. Yeah. Oh yeah. He used to tenor play with a boy. He played tenor kind of.

He played nice band. He used to play nice band. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I never did hear him play tenor much. He put down the tenor towards the end. What? He put the tenor down. He had to. I guess everybody wanted him to play clarinet. Yeah. Oh, I would have played tenor just before he died. But not often. No. He usually was playing clarinet there. Yeah, he could play boy. Did you play both clarinet and sax to the end of your career, or? Did you give clarinet up and play only sax? No, I played both of them. You played…
